integrity: All findings use explicitly specified mathematics and an independently reconstructible proof. Numerical checks are supplemental. Priority against unindexed equivalent literature is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one unit-amplitude actuator on an unweighted combinatorial-Laplacian path, finite T>0 and common damping mu>=0; not arbitrary weighted graphs, multi-actuator placement, normalized adjacency, trace/condition-number optimization or floating-point guarantees.
title: Unimodular single-node controllability and universal D-optimal ties on paths
